answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by decaying trust contributions exponentially with a defined half-life, requiring sustained honest service to build durable reputation. EigenTrust centrality propagates through reciprocal, credible interactions, so freshly spawned identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality and cannot meet consensus thresholds. A summit of colluding accounts is no oasis: trust cannot be minted like copper or gained merely by multiplying identities.
